details: Bitcoin price has shown a modest recovery, climbing above $63,000 after dipping to the low $59,000s. The market is navigating mixed signals from macro factors, including ongoing institutional ETF outflows, US-Iran tensions, and a hotter-than-expected US CPI print. Some analysts point to $64,000 as a key resistance level. Positive regulatory developments, such as Japan's move to regulate crypto like stocks, offer long-term tailwinds.
title: Bitcoin Recovers to $63K Amid Mixed Macro Signals

details: Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO has reportedly fueled over $1 billion in crypto bets, specifically impacting Hyperliquid (HYPE). The token saw a 6.54% surge, driven by speculation ahead of SpaceX's anticipated Nasdaq debut, highlighting the crossover between traditional markets and crypto speculation.
title: SpaceX IPO Hype Sparks $1 Billion Crypto Bets for Hyperliquid

details: Sam Bankman-Fried, founder of the collapsed FTX cryptocurrency exchange, has lost his appeal. A U.S. court has upheld his fraud conviction and 25-year sentence. This development confirms the legal repercussions for the disgraced crypto mogul following the high-profile collapse of FTX.
title: Sam Bankman-Fried Loses Appeal, FTX Fraud Conviction Upheld

details: BlackRock has submitted its final pre-launch forms for a Bitcoin Covered-Call ETF, aiming to provide yield on Bitcoin holdings with a 0.65% fee. Analysts suggest a launch could be within a week. This move by a major financial institution signals growing interest in diversified Bitcoin investment products for institutional investors.
title: BlackRock Files Final Forms for Bitcoin Covered-Call ETF

details: Binance has introduced "bStocks," offering 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks backed 1:1 by shares held in a regulated custodian. These tokenized securities, issued by a Binance affiliate, have received regulatory approval from ADGM's Financial Services Authority. This expands access to traditional equities within the crypto ecosystem.
title: Binance Launches bStocks for 24/7 Trading of Tokenized US Stocks

details: Solana-based decentralized exchange Raydium was exploited for $1.34 million on June 10th. An attacker drained funds from five deprecated liquidity pools of its legacy AMM V3 program, leveraging a smart contract vulnerability that had been dormant for five years. This highlights persistent security risks in DeFi.
title: Solana's Raydium DEX Suffers $1.34M Exploit

details: World Liberty Financial, a cryptocurrency project reportedly backed by President-elect Donald Trump, has acquired $10 million in Ethereum. This acquisition, coupled with strong performance from its token ONDO (which zoomed over 11% in 24 hours), highlights the project's growing momentum and its potential impact on the DeFi space.
title: Trump-Backed Project Acquires $10M in Ethereum
